shots.intent: 搜索首图干净合规，赢取第一眼点击。
用云台绿植氛围一秒传达滋润使用联想，承接首图。
shots.textZone: top headline zone with 「{selling_point_1}」 and a short sub-line 「{selling_point_2}」

shots.intent: 放大换季干燥紧绷的日常困扰，为产品登场铺垫。
并排呈现黑白两种膜布选择，让买家按需挑选。
shots.textZone: a short top label 「{selling_point_3}」 above the pair

shots.intent: 以微距纤维纹理证明膜布用料与裁切工艺。
用三张图标卡并列讲清核心优势，信息一眼可读。
shots.textZone: one short label under each icon, 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 以留空参数行回答规格疑问，数值后期再填。
shots.textZone: table row labels as short placeholders 「{callout_4}」 「{callout_5}」 「{callout_6}」 「{callout_7}」 with empty value cells

shots.intent: 白石子与贝壳的清爽平铺营造水感护理氛围。
用线稿示意敷贴步骤，替代真人面容并降低使用门槛。
以空白印章位预留资质位置，降低购买风险感。
shots.textZone: a short label strip beneath reading 「{callout_9}」

shots.intent: 深蓝底低角度收尾，突出行动按钮完成促单。

style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and trust screens, pale powder-blue #D9EAF2 family for podium and scene shots, warm ivory #F5F1E8 for icon-card and line-art shots
style.iconSystem: thin-line ink icons on white rounded cards, single accent color
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, upper-left front key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, airy and hydrating mood
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean hydrating skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, pale powder-blue #D9EAF2, warm ivory #F5F1E8, charcoal ink text #2B3440 and one seaweed-green accent #4E9E6F; bright soft studio lighting with an upper-left front key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product angle and scale with soft natural drape of the sheet; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 angle for podium and variant shots, straight-on for packshot and graphic shots; consistent soft drape rendering of the mask sheet
style.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone and smooth pebble surfaces, soft sheet-fabric texture for detail shots
